author: KEXP
description: On 'i live alone,' Seattle-based four-piece Plash debut with a dynamic set of guitar-heavy indie-rock featuring vocals in both English and Korean. Led by Jeseul Oh, the band join us on the KEXP Live Room to share a performance of "sona" and more from the album.
title: Plash performs "sona" & more Live on KEXP
